claim: The selectable text layer sits on the drawn words (frame offset applied to the layer, not the viewport)
evidence: pdf.ts:179 moves the layer by -frame.x/-frame.y and builds TextLayer with page.getViewport({ scale }). t1.json align at 1440: page 4 ink box l247.3 r630 t-268.2 b338 vs span box l247 r630.7 t-268.4 b338.5; page 3 within 3px; overlay t1-textlayer-overlay.png shows spans on the lines.

claim: page-flip animation loop stops when the book is destroyed (pnpm patch)
evidence: patches/page-flip@2.0.7.patch adds this.stopped|| to Render.start and render.stopped=!0 in destroy(); package.json has no module field so the bundler takes the patched dist/js/page-flip.browser.js; pnpm-lock.yaml patchedDependencies hash 4d51bad4...; shipped chunk out/_next/static/chunks/3y7oy_tt71u1t.js contains stopped||. t4.json: after leaving /book for /journal by RoomNav, 0 rAF/s and 0 workers. (The loop still runs every frame while mounted: READER-03.)

claim: «عرض للقراءة» keeps keyboard focus on its twin toggle
evidence: t3.json phone_reading.focus = "عرض الكتاب"; t4.json after three book/reading toggles focus returns to the group «صفحات من خوص».

claim: One page at a time, the canvas window reaches past skipped empty leaves
evidence: renderWindow(…, leaves) in book-preview.ts:82-98 with the PdfBookReader state effect passing leaves; t2.json at 360 on page 1: page 2 canvas already drawn (480x600) while hidden.

claim: Failed or abandoned loads destroy their pdf.js worker
evidence: pdf.ts:39-47 destroys the task on any failure; PdfBookReader.tsx:171 destroys a late result. t4.json blocked: 0 workers after the failure and after 3 failed retries, 1 after the good retry; 0 after leaving /book.

claim: From full screen «النسخ ←» reaches #editions even when the hash is already #editions
evidence: t9.json s157: /book#editions, full screen, End, click «النسخ»: fullscreen false, hash #editions, editions top at 122px of 900.

claim: A move asked for during a turn lands where asked (queued, not stacked)
evidence: go()/turn() store pendingRef while stateRef is flipping and replay it after read (PdfBookReader.tsx:211-213, 231-233, 372-381); keys.ts marks repeated Home/End as held. t1.json End -> [5|end] with «النسخ» visible.

claim: Portrait from the last (empty) spread does not strand the reader or arm a stale skip
evidence: t9.json book3: [blank|endpaper] at 1440 -> 700 shows the end leaf; «التالية» then reaches the back cover and stays.

claim: Alt/Ctrl/Meta chords are left to the browser
evidence: keys.ts:16 returns null for any modifier; tests/unit/book-keys.test.ts covers the four keys.

claim: «انتقل إلى» shows the pick at once and can be stepped with the arrows during a turn
evidence: picked state (PdfBookReader.tsx:558 value={picked ?? part.index}). t9.json book6: three ArrowDown presses showed المقدمة, من فصل «صورة الروضة», نهاية الصفحات المتاحة; the book ended on the [5|end] spread.

claim: The closing leaf is centred despite page-flip inline display:block
evidence: makeLeaf wraps the content in .endBody (flex, block-size 100%). t9.json book7: leaf 702px high, content from 233 to 469 (centre 351), centred horizontally (281 of 562); t9-end-leaf-1440.png.

claim: A second failed retry keeps focus on «إعادة المحاولة»
evidence: t4.json blocked.afterRetries.focus = BUTTON:إعادة المحاولة. The first attempt is still not covered: READER-05.

claim: The real-PDF ligature test can fail (it checks the reversed hamza-below case)
evidence: tests/unit/reader-mapping.test.ts:173-187 asserts reversedHamzaBelow and a fixed text without األ/اآل/اإل(?!ى).

claim: PLANS no longer require isEvalSupported:false or a patched PDF.js build for the reader
evidence: PLANS/WORK-PACKAGES.md:35 now reads "Lazy pdfjs-dist 6.3.289 (pinned; it has no eval path, isEvalSupported was removed upstream)"; the 6.3.289 build has no isEvalSupported/eval/new Function. DECISIONS.md:18 (D10) still says "Patched PDF.js" as settled history.

claim: The sitewide object-src none does not break opening the preview PDF directly (the no-JS and error fallback)
evidence: t8csp.mjs (re-run today, Chromium 153): the PDF served from a local server with the Pages headers (object-src none, base-uri, form-action, frame-ancestors, nosniff, X-Robots-Tag) opens in the built-in viewer at #page=4 (frames include the PDF viewer extension; t8csp-pdf-csp.png shows page 4 / 5).
